name: Emilia
source:
She is a slave who appears to be quite content with her status. Her heritage seems to be tied to one of the northernmost regions of Old Europe. 

As generations went by, she seems to retain the persistently pale skin and blonde hair of her ancestors, and even remembers some of the language they spoke. It is remarkable what people who find themselves in slavery are able to pass on despite their hardships.
